edges: Moumi Sébergué and Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert were part of the same delegation representing Chad in the 2008 Summer Olympics.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert competed on Chad's behalf as the national delegation's only female athlete at the Beijing games.
Chad made its first appearance at the Summer Olympics.
Chad has had no medalists in the Beijing Olympics.
Chad has had no medalists at the London Olympics.
